data.title: 夏祭烟花下的藏青浴衣回眸
data.location: 花火盛放的神社高台石阶
data.lighting: 高空金色烟花逆光与纸灯笼暖光
data.camera: 低机位仰拍七分身回眸
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, dark navy goldfish print yukata, crimson brocade obi, red hairpin, hair up in loose bun with long strands, holding candied apple, looking back over shoulder, subtle blush, gentle rare smile, golden eyes reflecting fireworks, shrine stone steps, bursting gold and red fireworks in night sky, warm lantern glow, backlit dark hair, from below, cowboy shot
data.animaCaption: Pausing on the shrine stone steps in a dark navy goldfish yukata with a crimson brocade obi, she turns back over her shoulder holding a glossy candied apple as fireworks bloom behind her. Golden sparks rim her pinned dark hair and warm her normally composed cheek.
data.promptProse: Captured from a low angle ascending the stone shrine steps during a summer night festival, Shiki Natsume wears a deep navy yukata patterned with subtle crimson goldfish, cinched with a rich red brocade obi and accented by a red kanzashi hairpin. Turning halfway back toward the viewer with a glazed candied apple held loosely in one hand, she reveals a faint, unguarded blush and rare soft smile while golden fireworks burst overhead in the indigo sky, rimming her black hair and gleaming warmly in her amber eyes.
data.story: 夜空忽然炸开一大朵金色花火，把石阶上的人影照得忽明忽暗。走在前面的夏目听见烟火声回过身，手里的苹果糖折射出暖光，嘴角挂着难得藏不住的浅笑——「光顾着看天上干什么？走散了我可不会回去找你。」
